title: Client Partner - Head of AI Foundations for GCP
jobDescription: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. Brief about the Team & Fractal: Fractal Analytics is a strategic analytics partner to the most admired Fortune 500 companies globally and helps them power every human decision in the enterprise by bringing analytics & AI to the decision-making process. We deliver insight, innovation, and impact to them by leveraging Big Data, analytics and technology and help them drive smarter, faster, and more accurate decisions in every aspect of their business. Overview Own GCP Data platform strategy, AI/ML infrastructure, data governance, responsible AI, and operations across all services delivered to enterprise clients globally. Build the systems that enable our India-based and distributed teams to deliver AI solutions reliably and at scale. Location: India (Bangalore) Reports to: CTO Key Responsibilities Data & Enterprise Context Build enterprise-grade data platform (Big Query, Dataflow, feature stores) Expertise in Data Mesh/ Data fabric architecture Implement RAG/knowledge base infrastructure for client context and grounding Design data governance, lineage, and compliance frameworks Establish data quality and SLA monitoring Responsible AI & Governance Implement RAI frameworks (fairness, bias monitoring, safety controls) Create monitoring systems for model performance, drift, hallucinations Establish responsible AI evaluation and deployment standards Ensure compliance and audit-readiness for enterprise clients Multi-Agentic Systems & Operations Build infrastructure for agentic systems (orchestration, tool use, memory) Design unified monitoring across platform, data, ML, LLMs, agents Establish SLOs, incident response, operational excellence practices Create dashboards and visibility for customer-facing systems Platform & Infrastructure Design and execute GCP platform strategy; architect for AI workloads at scale Implement training infrastructure for model fine-tuning and optimization Manage infrastructure costs and Fin Ops practices Establish platform standards and architectural patterns Team & Delivery Build and scale high-performing India-based platform engineering team Partner with delivery/services teams to enable client implementations Own enterprise readiness and customer requirements Hire, develop, and mentor engineering talent Coordinate with global leadership on platform roadmap Required Experience 12+ years infrastructure/platform engineering; 5+ years leading technical teams Deep GCP expertise (Compute, Big Query, Vertex AI, GKE, data services) Enterprise data platform design (100GB+ datasets, complex ETL/streaming) Experience with distributed systems, databases, and large-scale data processing Strong understanding of ML/LLM fundamentals and modern AI systems Proven ability to build and lead large technical teams Executive presence; ability to communicate with C-suite and enterprise customers Required Competencies Architectural vision for multi-year platform evolution Systems thinking; optimization across interdependent components Technical depth; hands-on leadership across infrastructure and ML Strategic leadership; making sound trade-off decisions with long-term implications Execution excellence; translating strategy into metrics and delivery Cross-functional influence; strong partnerships with delivery, product, engineering teams Cost consciousness and Fin Ops mindset Continuous learning in rapidly evolving AI landscape Work Environment Location: India (Bangalore ) Work Setup: Hybrid flexible Travel: 5-10% for client meetings, team offsites, conferences Team Interaction: Lead India-based team; regular sync with global leadership Work Hours: Flexible core hours with some overlap with global timezones Why Join Us Leading AI Company: India-based role at global AI-driven services company Strategic Impact: Direct influence on platform powering enterprise AI solutions Technical Leadership: Work with cutting-edge LLMs, agentic systems, enterprise AI Team Building: Build and scale high-performing India-based engineering organization Growth Opportunity: Significant growth potential; 10x scaling ahead Global Scope: Lead systems serving enterprise clients globally while based in India Execution Focus: Balance innovation with reliable delivery to enterprise customers If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
jobDescription: Our global procurement team is hiring procurement professional who has prior extensive experience of handling sourcing and procurement operation across Pan India & Overseas. He / She can manage & source global vendor per the procurement policy & guidelines. Extensively work with vendors/suppliers for onboarding as per Fractal’s supplier onboarding protocol, supplier selection by following the right procurement policies & procedures, review & negotiate the contract commercial clauses, record keeping of suppliers, handling audits, contract management and other day to day procurement activities. If you are an exceptional procurement enthusiast and loves to push the boundaries to solve complex sourcing & procurement problems using innovative solutions, then we would like to talk with you. Role Details Section 1 (Roles and Responsibilities) · Accountable for supplier onboarding on ERP (Microsoft D365) with precise document verification and record keeping & tagging. · Solicit help & support to all vendors in onboarding supplier successfully as well as train vendor on vendor portal usage. · Manage purchase requests and apply sourcing strategies to source quality vendors. · Draft RFQ or RFP documents to source quotes/proposals for open PRs from all assigned departments as per the alignment from the senior procurement manager. · Supplier Selection by following the right procurement policies & procedures · Prepare Selection Reports and get necessary approvals before proceeding for PO · Open PR/PO management. Release PO in time with accuracy. · Communicate/Collaborate with suppliers for deliveries to various centers across India and Away. · Upkeep procurement records for any audits as per the policy guidelines. · Record all procurement contracts and its lifecycle in contract management system and intimate team on upcoming renewals. · Prepare procurement reports and dashboard as per the organization needs. · Drive sustainable procurement practice to mitigate carbon emission and contribute to Fractal’s carbon neutrality program. · Drive Supplier Diversity Goals. · Handle reverse auction events on reverse auction tools as and when required. · Manage procurement operation day to day activities Section 2 (Mandatory technical skills) Must Have: · Comprehensive knowledge on indirect procurement with an IT/ITES or large organization on global front. · Experience in categories like Administration, IT, Manpower Services, Professional Services. · Experience working with stakeholders from IT, Admin, HR, Marketing, Finance & Legal, etc. · Experience facing internal and external audits. · Experience in handling RFPs with commercial & technical weightage. · In depth Hands-on Experience with sourcing & procurement tools · Able to draft & execute SOP’s for procurement services. · Ability to draft & review commercial contract clauses. · Expert-level proficiency in Ms-office packages i.e. MS Excel, MS Word, Power point, Power BI, etc. · Strong understanding and experience on ERP(Microsoft D365) and management tools & application. · Good Experience in contract Lifecycle Management using contract management platforms. Good to Have: · Spend Analysis & Reporting, Section 3 (Mandatory non-technical skills) Presentation Skills, Reporting Skills, Negotiation Skills, Project Management, Commercial Acumen. Section 4 (Education Qualification and Certifications required, If any) · Any Graduate. Engineering degree/MBA is preferred. · Certification in procurement like CPP/CIPS/CPSM is desirable. If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! title: Data Scientist/ Senior Data Scientist- NLP GenAI
jobDescription:
Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs). Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions. Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs. Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development. Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards. Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility. Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment. Technical Skills: Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation. Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis. Generative AI: Proficiency with Saa S LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, Re Act, agents). Experience with Azure Open AI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities. Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like Tensor Flow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization. Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred. Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, Fast API/Django/Flask, and Git.

EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent. If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! title: AI Platform Architect: Agentic & Generative AI - Cogentiq
jobDescription:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. AI Platform Architect: Agentic & Generative AI
- Cogentiq About Cogentiq (Fractal’s Agentic AI Platform): Cogentiq is Fractal’s secure, scalable, enterprise agentic AI platform that enables teams to build, test, deploy, monitor agents and multi‑agent workflows with strong observability, evaluation, guardrails and RBAC across any cloud or LLM framework. It includes a no/low‑code development console, Agent & MCP Gateways, and an enterprise marketplace for reusable agents, tools, connections and guardrails. Role Overview As an AI Platform Architect, you will design and scale enterprise-grade Agentic AI and Generative AI platforms that power copilots, autonomous workflows, and multi-agent systems. This is a hands-on architect role for a builder who combines deep distributed-systems thinking with practical expertise in LLMs, agent orchestration, and cloud-native platforms. You will define reference architectures, engineering standards, and core platform capabilities that enable teams to build, deploy, and operate AI systems at scale. Key Responsibilities Platform & Architecture Leadership Architect scalable Agentic AI platforms supporting multi-agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, planning, and reasoning workflows Design end-to-end Gen AI platforms, including: Prompt orchestration Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines Vector databases LLM integrations Define modular, microservices-based, API-first architectures enabling rapid development of AI copilots and autonomous systems Agentic & Gen AI Systems Define architectural patterns for: Agent orchestration and coordination Planning, reflection, and reasoning loops Human-in-the-loop and feedback-driven systems Evaluate and integrate emerging frameworks such as Lang Chain, Llama Index, Auto Gen, Crew AI, and related ecosystems into enterprise platforms Production Readiness & Reliability Ensure production-grade reliability across AI platforms, including: Observability and monitoring Evaluation and experimentation frameworks Guardrails, safety, and governance Cost optimization for LLM-based systems Lead architecture across LLMOps, MLOps, and platform operations Cloud, Dev Ops & Infrastructure Drive cloud-native platform architecture using AWS, Azure, or GCP Lead Kubernetes-based deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) Ensure scalability, security, and resilience of AI workloads Collaboration & Technical Leadership Partner with data science, product, and business teams to translate AI use cases into robust platform capabilities Mentor senior engineers and architects; set engineering standards, reference architectures, and best practices Act as a technical thought leader for enterprise AI platform strategy Required Skills & Experience 12–15 years of experience in platform engineering / architecture, with strong depth in distributed systems Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP) and Kubernetes-based architectures Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate) Strong understanding of agentic frameworks, multi-agent systems, and orchestration patterns Experience across LLMOps / MLOps, including: Model deployment Monitoring and evaluation Lifecycle and version management Proficiency in microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, and scalable backend engineering Strong coding experience in Python / Java / Go, with system-design depth Experience working with data platforms (real-time + batch, large-scale data processing) Solid understanding of AI safety, governance, and responsible AI frameworks Good to Have Experience building enterprise AI copilots or autonomous workflows Exposure to reasoning frameworks, chain-of-thought orchestration, and agent memory systems Prior consulting or client-facing experience leading AI-driven transformations What We’re Looking For A builder–architect who combines deep engineering rigor with a strong grasp of Agentic and Generative AI—someone who can turn cutting-edge AI concepts into scalable, secure, and production-ready enterprise platforms. If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
